body:
Founder: 'abstract into material first so it cleanly translates into papercraft' / 'build the shaders in to the native and then refer to the shaders from NOCK directly ... just like the ffi names not the real shader code.' New shankpit_materials table (name/shader_name/texture_id/specular/shininess), seeded brick/concrete/wood/metal. Export embeds the live materials registry. shader_name validated against a real, small, native-shader-name allowlist (VS0: 'standard' only -- an emissive VS1 shader is real, deferred). 6 new tests pass, full suite green. NOCK gets a material dropdown per wall + a minimal materials manager panel. Live-verified: real 4-material test level created, exported, resolved correctly by the real native parser, rendered through the real level_select_confirm() flow under Xvfb. Commit IDUNA 3d8e034.

⚓ ☃
title: Ship SHANKPIT block materials + named shader registry backend
